> **Reason for Removal – 1456 Lanier Pl NE, Atlanta, GA 30306**
>

>
> The crown also contains large dead limbs positioned above the deck, stairs and roofline. The deck is an occupied gathering area used regularly by the household. A failure of the leaning stem or of these limbs would strike people, the deck, or the house.
>
> In addition, the trunk is growing directly against the rear deck stairs. The lean and the structural conflict can't be corrected by pruning: reducing the weight enough to address the lean would remove a large share of the live crown and further stress the tree.

Sharper Edge Tree Care Inc, a registered tree service, will remove the tree in sections using climbing and rigging to protect the deck, stairs and house.
